data.summary_suggestion: Create a webhook subscription for events
data.description_suggestion: Creates a new webhook subscription to receive events (prospects and/or sales) for a specific space or the entire account if `space` is omitted. The response includes a `secret` that is returned only once—store it securely as it cannot be retrieved later. Each webhook delivery includes an `X-Subtraq-Signature` header containing a timestamp and HMAC-SHA256 signature computed from the timestamp and request body using this secret. Private and local IP addresses are not allowed as webhook URLs. Account is limited to 20 webhook subscriptions maximum; attempting to exceed this limit returns a `webhook_limit_reached` error.

data.description_suggestion: Updates a link's properties including destination URL, label, short address (domain and/or slug), or archive status. Links are never deleted—when archived, they stop redirecting (including all previous short URLs) but their historical data is preserved. Supports partial updates via PATCH. Returns the updated link object. Supports idempotent requests via the `Idempotency-Key` header.
